text:
viv: Quick postmortem follow-up: auth provider latency triggered a token-refresh surge that overloaded model-registry. Need owners, minimal mitigations, and dates.

omar: I'll own gateway changes. Short fix: cap auth retries to 2, add exponential backoff + jitter, and feature-flag a circuit-breaker that fails to cached tokens after 5 errors. PR by Mon.

sre-bot: Created INC-5902: 'auth token churn -> registry overload'. Temp owner viv. DR dry-run scheduled 2027-05-02 10:00 UTC.

jade: I'll own registry fallback & metrics. Implement cached-token fallback for transient 5xx, safety TTL 5m, and emit metrics token.refresh.rate and token.refresh.errors. Staging by Thu.

cloud-liaison: Opening support case with provider and requesting auth endpoint traces; will post case # and any findings by EOD.

viv: Action list:
- A1 (omar): gateway retry cap + backoff + circuit. PR Mon 2027-03-29, canary Wed.
- A2 (jade): registry cached-token fallback + metrics + dashboard. Staging Thu 2027-04-01.
- A3 (cloud-liaison): provider logs & escalation. Case # by EOD.
- A4 (sre-bot): schedule DR + add runbook snippet to fallback to long-lived tokens if needed. DR 2027-05-02.

omar: I'll also add a CI scenario simulating 500ms auth latency to validate fallback.

jade: I'll pin alerts: token.refresh.errors > 0.2% for 5m -> P1.

viv: Noted this pattern twice recently. Proposal: 6-week rotating dependency check (30m/week). Volunteers?

cloud-liaison: I'll take week 1.

viv: Post short status updates here only (e.g., 'omar: PR merged', 'jade: staging metrics live', 'cloud-liaison: case #PV-9988'). We'll close when prod rollouts are verified and DR passes.
